entry.title: Calibrated evidence in a particle search
entry.summary: The observed spectrum is compatible with the specified background model across the complete fitted interval. Consequently, the measurement constrains the interaction strength without establishing evidence for a new resonance.

entry.title: A systematic comparison of production channels
entry.summary: Several production channels yield compatible parameter estimates when evaluated with the same perturbative prescription. The combined constraint is therefore more precise, although correlated uncertainties remain important.
